description: Shenzhen Open Data Platform (深圳市政府数据开放平台) is a data portal run by Shenzhen Municipal Government. The municipal platform lists data sets and interfaces from Shenzhen agencies in transport, resources, energy, water and public services, in CSV, XLS and API form, with a login for downloads. Coverage: Shenzhen. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as csv, xlsx, api; access is free of charge with registration for downloads. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("深圳市政府数据开放平台") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support urban infrastructure demand and operation studies of Shenzhen. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
